name: rich-text-editor
title: Rich text editor
description: A dependency-free rich text editor with a formatting toolbar and sanitized HTML in and out.
a11y: The editing region has role="textbox", aria-multiline and an accessible name; the toolbar is a named toolbar with one tab stop and arrow-key movement.
Toggle buttons (bold, italic, underline, lists, headings, quote) carry aria-pressed that follows the selection.
Cmd/Ctrl+B, I, U and K apply bold, italic, underline and open the link prompt; Escape in the toolbar returns focus to the editor.
The link prompt is a labelled popover; an invalid address is announced as an alert and links are limited to http, https and mailto.
Pasted content is sanitized to a small tag allowlist; disabled and read-only set aria-disabled and aria-readonly and turn the toolbar off.
